summary: Verified 3 new features (regenerate, rename chat, folders + move) plus chat regression via backend pytest (6/6) and Playwright UI E2E (7/7). All flows work end-to-end and persist server-side.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar.jsx has no data-testid for the chat action menu container itself (the pop-over uses inline z-50), and the outside-click overlay uses z-40 which is fine but relies on stopPropagation on menu items — considered clean.
renameChat in ChatApp.jsx does optimistic update but does NOT revert on API failure (silently only toasts). Low priority — the PATCH endpoint tested green.

handleRegenerate depends on `messages` closure without adding it to a useCallback dep list (it isn't a useCallback though, just a function each render, so OK); regenerate correctly strips trailing assistant before sending — server also strips trailing assistant, so no duplication observed.
Consider adding data-testid on the composer's mode/web toggles' pressed state, and on the chat action-menu popup container for future test resiliency.
test_credentials: localStorage claus_token=test_session_qa_01 (user_testqa01, qa@claus.test). Same as Bearer token for API.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed folders and transient chats; each cleans up its own resources via DELETE. Pre-existing folder 'Lavoro' and QA chats left intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL and Bearer token verified working. Regenerate endpoint POST /api/chats/{id}/regenerate correctly deletes the trailing assistant message before streaming a new one — count stays 1 user + 1 assistant. Folder PATCH accepts either {folder_id: X} or {clear_folder: true}. UI test flow: inject localStorage.claus_token BEFORE page.goto, then navigate again to trigger auth. All new-feature data-testids listed in the review request are present and clickable.
